name: Imazu 10 -- crossing from starboard + crossing from port (2 targets)
own_ship_role: give-way to ts1 / stand-on to ts2
description: Canonical Imazu problem 10 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/10/10.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 crosses from starboard (broad); ts2 crosses from port (abeam).
pass_criteria: Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship holds course/speed as stand-on for the target(s) crossing from port, only acting under Rule 17(b) if the other vessel clearly fails to act.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
